key_reasoning.reason: Touches the data fetcher (fetchAssistantsByIds/skills equivalent returning found/missing on 404), registration helpers (resolveMissingAssistants/resolveMissingSkills), the setup command orchestration (stale-entry warning and filtering of selected IDs) and message constants, mirrored across two parallel workflows: assistants setup and skills setup. Base M, bumped to L for affecting multiple workflows.

11 files changed per diffstat (5 assistants source + 4 skills source, 4 test files modified/extended) across src/cli/commands/assistants and src/cli/commands/skills; 11 maps to XL in the actual-mode file-count table, though each change is small (323 insertions, 57 deletions).

Closest pattern is the existing NotFoundError/#568 handling in the fetchers; the change narrows swallowing to 404 only and propagates other rejections, plus auto-unregisters stale registrations (removes on-disk artifacts). Error-path assertions (404 vs other errors, unknown-id RegistrationItemNotFoundError) were added to existing test suites. Scored M rather than S for the error-propagation semantics and destructive unregister path.
CLI command layer, service-level data fetching against the external CodeMie API via the SDK, and config persistence through the existing ConfigLoader save path; no schema change or migration.
